input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data. Relative paths are read from the launch directory; relative FASTQ paths in the samplesheet are read from the samplesheet's folder.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with a header row and at least the columns 'sample', 'fastq_cDNA' and 'fastq_BC_UMI'. Relative FASTQ paths are read from the samplesheet's folder.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved, created if missing. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

protocol.description: Sequencing technology, which selects the pre-processing and the read layout in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

ref_gtf_alt.description: Deprecated: the Cell Ranger and split-pipe references are built from 'ref_gtf'; this parameter has no effect.

ref_fasta_addfeature.description: Extra sequences (e.g. a consensus rDNA unit) appended to 'ref_fasta' for mapping. Records that copy sequence already in 'ref_fasta' are dropped. Every read on an added contig counts as an rRNA read.

ref_gtf_addfeature.description: rRNA loci (GTF rows of any feature type) on contigs of 'ref_fasta' or 'ref_fasta_addfeature', counted in the read-level rRNA metrics. Not added to the mapping annotation, so the count matrices are unaffected.

bc_whitelist.description: Barcode whitelist(s): one or more URLs or paths separated by whitespace, one per barcode segment in segment order. URLs are downloaded.

bc_whitelist_parse_splitwells.description: Well whitelist the Parse Biosciences demultiplexing splits the reads on.

parse_collapse_bc1.description: Parse Biosciences: rewrite each read's round-1 barcode to its well's oligo-dT barcode before mapping, so a cell's oligo-dT, random-hexamer and targeted reads form one cell. Needs 'bc_whitelist_parse_splitwells'.

scalebio_max_mismatches.description: ScaleBio: substitutions corrected per barcode (Hamming distance). Unset uses the protocol's setting (1).

scalebio_i5_revcomp.description: ScaleBio: whether the I2 read holds the PCR (i5) index reverse-complemented, as on some sequencers. 'auto' decides per lane from its first 200,000 reads.

scalebio_write_unassigned.description: ScaleBio: also write the reads whose barcodes are valid but whose RT/PCR wells belong to no sample, to demultiplex/scalebio/<library>/.

scalebio_ultima_tags.description: ScaleBio, Ultima CRAMs: the SAM tag holding each barcode, as 'segment=TAG[:START],...', START being where the barcode begins in the tag's value (0-based) when a constant linker comes first. Unset uses the protocol's (QuantumScale: 'pcr=RG,bead1=b1,bead2=b2:4,bead3=b3:4,rt=b4').

scalebio_ultima_umi.description: ScaleBio, Ultima CRAMs: where the UMI is, 'tag:XX' (a SAM tag) or 'seq:START:LENGTH' (its place in the read, 0-based; it is cut from the cDNA). Unset uses the protocol's (QuantumScale: 'tag:UM').

cram_type.description: What the samplesheet's 'cram' files hold: 'illumina', unaligned read pairs with the index reads in the BC/QT tags (any protocol; converted to FASTQ), or 'ultima', Ultima Genomics reads whose ScaleBio barcodes the Ultima trimmer moved into tags (ScaleBio only).

cram_reference.description: FASTA the 'cram' files were compressed against. Unaligned CRAMs need none.

cram_index_format.description: How the index reads are read from a CRAM's BC tag (samtools fastq --index-format), e.g. 'i8i8' when two indices are joined without a separator. 'auto' counts the indices by their separator ('ACGT-TTGG' is two).

run_method.description: Which part of the pipeline runs: 'standard', 'geneext_only', 'external_pipeline_only' or 'post_mapping', which picks a finished run up where mapping ended and redoes everything after it.

previous_outdir.description: Results directory the 'post_mapping' run method reads the published mapping results back from. Defaults to 'outdir'.

seqspec_file.description: seqspec file with the read layout, for protocol 'seqspec'.

bcl2fastq.description: Extra bcl2fastq options; set per protocol in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

mapping_software.description: Mapper(s) to run: 'starsolo', 'alevin' (alevin-fry), 'both' or 'alevin_starsolo' (the two together), or 'alevin_subsampled_starsolo'.

cellfilter_method.description: How cells are called: 'star_solocellfilter' (each mapper's own filter: STARsolo's --soloCellFilter, alevin-fry's knee), 'second_derivative' or 'manual_cutoff'. The last two filter every mapper's matrix on a UMI cutoff.

alevin_usa_counts.description: alevin-fry spliced (S), unspliced (U) and ambiguous (A) counts summed into each gene's count. Only SUA matches STARsolo's GeneFull_Ex50pAS; SA matches STARsolo's Gene.

alevin_resolution.description: alevin-fry UMI resolution. cr-like discards UMIs that stay ambiguous between genes, as Cell Ranger and STARsolo with star_soloMultiMappers 'Unique' do; cr-like-em splits them by expectation-maximisation, the counterpart of STARsolo's default 'EM'.

skip_barcode_check.description: Never cancel a sample for barcodes that do not match the whitelist.

min_barcode_match.description: Percentage of the checked reads whose barcode is on the whitelist (exact match) below which a sample is cancelled before mapping; 0 disables the check.

barcode_check_reads.description: Number of reads the barcode check reads per sample, from the start of the barcode FASTQ.

skip_mapping_rate_check.description: Never cancel a sample for a low mapping rate.

min_mapping_rate.description: Percentage of reads uniquely mapped (STARsolo) or mapped (salmon) below which a sample is cancelled.

mapping_rate_action.description: What a failed mapping-rate check or barcode check does: stop the pipeline, or drop only that sample.

mapping_rate_check_reads.description: STARsolo: check the mapping rate mid-run once this many reads are processed; 0 checks only at the end.

mapping_rate_poll_secs.description: How often a running mapper is checked, in seconds.

subsample_nreads.description: Reads per sample for the 'alevin_subsampled_starsolo' STARsolo runs.

star_index.description: Prebuilt STARsolo index to map against; built in the run when unset.

mt_contig.description: Mitochondrial contig name(s) in the reference, separated by spaces. Reads on them count as mtDNA, and their genes are the mitochondrial genes of the metacell report and of CellSweep.

star_generateBAM.description: Write the STARsolo BAM, needed for the read metrics, saturation and Kraken.

star_limitBAMsortRAM.description: STAR --limitBAMsortRAM in bytes; 0 derives it from the task memory minus the genome index.

star_limitGenomeGenerateRAM.description: STAR --limitGenomeGenerateRAM in bytes; derived from the task memory when unset.

star_soloStrand.description: Strand of the reads relative to the gene (STAR --soloStrand; alevin-fry and the antisense metrics follow it). Unset: 'Forward', or 'Reverse' for samples read from Ultima CRAMs (cram_type 'ultima').

star_genomeSAsparseD.description: STAR's --genomeSAsparseD: suffix array sparsity of the index. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_genomeChrBinNbits.description: STAR --genomeChrBinNbits for the index build; derived as min(18, log2(max(genome length / number of sequences, read length))) when unset.

star_soloFeatures.description: STARsolo's --soloFeatures: the features UMIs are counted for. Velocyto is added by 'perform_velocity'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_outFilterScoreMin.description: STAR's --outFilterScoreMin: the lowest alignment score that is written. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_outSAMattributes.description: STAR's --outSAMattributes: the SAM attributes written to the BAM. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_outSAMunmapped.description: STAR's --outSAMunmapped: whether unmapped reads are written to the BAM. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_soloTypestring.description: STARsolo's --soloType with the barcode and UMI layout of the reads, e.g. '--soloType CB_UMI_Simple --soloCBstart 1 --soloCBlen 16 --soloUMIstart 17 --soloUMIlen 12'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config. Not used with protocol 'seqspec', whose layout comes from the seqspec file.

star_soloCBmatchWLtype.description: STARsolo's --soloCBmatchWLtype: how cell barcodes are matched to the whitelist. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_soloUMIfiltering.description: STARsolo's --soloUMIfiltering: which UMIs are filtered out. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_soloMultiMappers.description: STARsolo counting of multi-gene reads, and so the matrix analysed: 'Unique' (raw/matrix.mtx) or 'EM', 'Uniform', 'PropUnique', 'Rescue' (raw/UniqueAndMult-<type>.mtx, fractional). Defaults to the protocol's: 'PropUnique' for ScaleBio, 'EM' for the others.

star_clipAdapterType.description: STAR's --clipAdapterType: adapter clipping. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_extraargs.description: Further STAR options, added to the protocol's own (conf/seqtech_parameters.config). An option given here replaces the protocol's option of the same name.

star_genomeSAindexNbases.description: STAR's --genomeSAindexNbases: length of the suffix array pre-index. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_solocellfilter.description: STARsolo's --soloCellFilter, as the filter name only (e.g. 'EmptyDrops_CR', 'CellRanger2.2', 'None'): the pipeline adds the filter's arguments, starting with the sample's expected_cells. It decides the cells only with cellfilter_method 'star_solocellfilter'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

star_soloUMIdedup.description: STARsolo's --soloUMIdedup: how UMIs are deduplicated. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

alevin_bc_geometry.description: alevin-fry position(s) of the cell barcode, e.g. '1[1-16]' or '1[1-9,14-22,27-35]'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config. Protocol 'seqspec' has none, so it must be set there to run alevin-fry.

alevin_umi_geometry.description: alevin-fry position of the UMI, e.g. '1[17-28]'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config. Protocol 'seqspec' has none, so it must be set there to run alevin-fry.

alevin_read_geometry.description: alevin-fry position of the biological sequence, '2[1-end]' for every protocol. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

preprocessing_options.title: Pre-processing options
preprocessing_options.description: Protocol-specific pre-processing; the defaults per protocol are in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

perform_demultiplexing.description: Demultiplex the FASTQ files of protocols that need it (MARS-seq, OAK, Parse Biosciences, sci-RNA-seq3).

oak_demux_max_mismatches.description: OAK: Hamming distance allowed between a read's index and the aliquot's i7/i5 barcodes.

marsseq_read1_design.description: MARS-seq layout of read 1 for demultiplexing, e.g. '5I4B45M5I'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

marsseq_read2_design.description: MARS-seq layout of read 2 for demultiplexing, e.g. '6W4R5I'. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

perform_10x_saturate.description: Compute the sequencing saturation curves with 10x_saturate.

saturation_target.description: Sequencing saturation (0 to 1) for which the number of reads needed is predicted.

perform_geneext.description: Extend the annotation with GeneExt, from full-data STARsolo alignments, and re-map every mapper against the extended annotation.

geneext_downstream.description: Only consulted with 'perform_geneext': 'geneext_only' maps, reports and analyses downstream only the runs on the extended annotation; 'both' also the standard-annotation runs, for a comparison.

geneext_gtf.description: Extended annotation 'post_mapping' re-uses; defaults to gene_ext/geneext.gtf under 'previous_outdir'.

geneext_bam_only.description: Strip a STARsolo pass that is mapped only for GeneExt down to producing the BAM GeneExt reads, skipping the count matrices and the cell call.

geneext_subsample_nreads.description: Per-sample cap on the reads reaching GeneExt, applied before the BAMs are merged so one deeply sequenced sample cannot dominate the extension. 0 disables it.

geneext_subsamplebam.description: GeneExt's own --subsamplebam, applied to the merged BAM. Downsamples uniformly and so does not balance samples against each other; use 'geneext_subsample_nreads' for that.

perform_velocity.description: Also count for RNA velocity: STARsolo's Velocyto feature (spliced, unspliced, ambiguous) and alevin-fry's unspliced counts, with a velocity-ready .h5ad per mapper.

perform_featurecounts.description: Deprecated: the mtDNA, rRNA and antisense read metrics always run for a STARsolo BAM; this parameter has no effect.

grep_rrna.description: Text that marks the rRNA features in the annotation, used to count rRNA reads.

h5ad_compression.description: HDF5 compression of the AnnData objects: 'gzip', 'lzf' (several times faster to write, about 15% larger, readable only through h5py) or 'none'.

perform_doublet_detection.description: Call consensus doublets and annotate them.

perform_doublet_filtering.description: Remove the consensus doublets from the UMI matrix instead of annotating them (needs 'perform_doublet_detection').

doublet_consensus_method.description: Combine_Results.R method; AnySinglet calls a doublet only if all tools agree (intersection), AnyDoublet if any tool calls it (union).

demuxafy_sif.description: Demuxafy Singularity image; when unset, <outdir>/containers/demuxafy/Demuxafy.sif is reused if present, otherwise downloaded (~7.5 GB).

metacell_options.title: Metacell and filtering report options
metacell_options.description: Metacell2 grouping, the interactive filtering report, and applying its selection.

perform_metacells.description: Group called cells into Metacell2 metacells and build filtering_report.html.

mc2_target_metacell_size.description: Metacell2's target number of cells per metacell.

mc2_random_seed.description: Seed for Metacell2's random steps, fixed so that a rerun reproduces the assignment a selection was made on.

mc2_min_cell_umis.description: Cells with fewer UMIs are not grouped; they are reported as the '__excluded__' group.

mc2_max_cell_umis.description: Cells with more UMIs are not grouped; they are reported as the '__excluded__' group. Unset: no upper limit.

mc2_max_excluded_genes_fraction.description: Metacell2's cap on the fraction of a cell's UMIs in excluded (e.g. mitochondrial) genes. Unset: off, so mito-rich cells stay visible in the report.

mc2_excluded_gene_patterns.description: Extra genes kept out of the grouping, as space-separated regular expressions. The mitochondrial genes are always excluded.

mc2_lateral_gene_patterns.description: Genes marked lateral (e.g. cell-cycle genes), as space-separated regular expressions. They do not drive the grouping but are still used to detect outliers.

mc2_min_cells.description: Fewest groupable cells a sample needs; a sample with fewer is shown in the report as skipped.

mc2_skip_subsampled.description: Make no metacells for the '_subsampled_starsolo' and '_geneext_subsampled_starsolo' runs.

gene_annotation.description: Protein domains (PFAM) per gene, transcript or protein id: pfam_scan.pl output, eggNOG-mapper's .emapper.annotations, or a TSV with or without header.

gene_annotation_format.description: Format of 'gene_annotation'; 'auto' detects it from the file's first lines.

gene_annotation_id_col.description: Identifier column of a 'gene_annotation' with header. For eggNOG-mapper, 'query' is used when the file has no such column.

gene_annotation_pfam_col.description: Domain column of a 'gene_annotation' with header. For eggNOG-mapper, 'PFAMs' is used when the file has no such column.

gene_annotation_name_col.description: Gene name column of a 'gene_annotation' with header; eggNOG-mapper's Preferred_name is used without it.

mcfilter_max_mito_pct.description: Filtering report's starting threshold on mitochondrial UMIs per metacell (%). Unset: the threshold starts switched off.

mcfilter_max_doublet_pct.description: Filtering report's starting threshold on consensus doublets per metacell (%). Unset: the threshold starts switched off.

mcfilter_max_alpha_hat.description: Filtering report's starting threshold on the mean CellSweep ambient fraction per metacell. Unset: the threshold starts switched off.

mcfilter_min_gene_umis.description: Filtering report's starting minimum of total UMIs per gene.

mcfilter_pfam_presets.description: Domain regular expressions offered as one-click presets in the filtering report, separated by ';'.

metacell_selection.description: selection.json exported from filtering_report.html; rerun with -resume to apply it.

metacell_gene_mode.description: 'drop' removes the excluded genes from the final matrices; 'flag' keeps every gene and records the decision in var['pass_filter'] and var['exclusion_reasons'].

perform_kraken.description: Classify the unmapped reads with Kraken2.

kraken_db_path.description: Existing Kraken2 database; the PlusPF 16 GB database is downloaded when unset.

perform_cellranger.description: Also run the Cell Ranger pipeline.

splitpipe_installation.description: Path to the split-pipe (Parse Biosciences) installation folder.

splitpipe_conda_env.description: Conda environment with split-pipe: a name, an environment file or a prefix directory.

splitpipe_demultiplex_script.description: split-pipe's demultiplexing script; the pipeline's own demultiplexer runs when unset.

splitpipe_kit.description: split-pipe kit name, e.g. 'WT', passed as --kit with --kit_score_skip. Unset: split-pipe scores the kit itself.

rhapsody_installation.description: Path to the BD Rhapsody pipeline installation folder.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

help_full.description: Display the full help message, hidden parameters included.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message.

pipeline_version.description: The pipeline version. Read back by manifest.version and by the help banner; not intended to be set on the command line.

email.description: Email address for the completion summary.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for the completion summary, sent only when the pipeline fails.

plaintext_email.description: Send the summary email as plain text instead of HTML.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log output.

custom_config_base.description: Base directory or URL of the institutional configs (nf-core/configs).

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id of the institutional configs (nf-core/configs).

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL of a messaging service (Slack or Microsoft Teams) to post the run summary to.

perform_trimming.description: Trim adapters and low-quality bases with fastp, where applicable (sci-RNA-seq3 and seqspec protocols).

fastp_length_required.description: fastp's --length_required: reads shorter than this are dropped. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.

fastp_qualified_quality_phred.description: fastp's --qualified_quality_phred: the base quality from which a base counts as qualified. Unset: the protocol's default in conf/seqtech_parameters.config.
